Maverick Ambitions HVAC is a licensed HVAC contractor serving Newark, NJ and surrounding communities in Essex, Union, and Hudson counties since 2012, operating 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, under Master HVAC License 19HC00912900.

Maverick Ambitions HVAC provides residential AC installation, AC repair, heating installation and repair, AC maintenance, emergency HVAC service, and commercial AC service across Newark and northern New Jersey. Same-day appointments are available. The diagnostic fee applies toward repair cost. Call (862) 279-3408 to schedule.

In 23 years of HVAC work across Newark and northern New Jersey, founder John Brown has seen every failure mode a residential or commercial system can produce. After completing installations across hundreds of Newark homes, we have learned that sizing and placement decisions made at installation determine system performance for the next fifteen years. Maverick Ambitions HVAC has provided residential and commercial HVAC service in Newark, NJ since 2012.

RESIDENTIAL AND COMMERCIAL HVAC SERVICES IN NEWARK

From first-time AC installation to 24-hour emergency heating repair, we handle the full range of residential and commercial HVAC needs right here in the Newark area.

Residential AC Installation

A correctly sized and licensed AC installation keeps Newark homes cool all summer while protecting the manufacturer warranty.

Learn more
Residential AC Services

From seasonal tune-ups to full system replacements, we handle every residential AC need in one visit.

Learn more
AC Maintenance

Our $17.99/month tune-up plan keeps your system running efficiently and catches small faults before they become expensive repairs.

Learn more
Heating Installation & Repair

Licensed heating installation and fast repair response keeps Newark properties warm through every New Jersey winter.

Learn more
24-Hour Emergency HVAC

When your system fails at 2 a.m. in July or January, we respond, no voicemail, no next-day callback.

Learn more
Commercial AC Services

Restaurants, gyms, and commercial properties across Newark rely on us for licensed commercial AC installation, repair, and emergency coverage.

Learn more
23 YEARS OF LICENSED HVAC EXPERTISE IN NEWARK

In 23 years of HVAC work across Newark and northern New Jersey, John Brown has seen every failure mode a residential or commercial system can produce. He founded Maverick Ambitions HVAC in 2012 and has operated from Newark ever since, building a track record based on how systems actually perform, not on how they look on a quote sheet.

We hold Master HVAC License 19HC00912900, verifiable through the New Jersey Division of Consumer Affairs. A licensed contractor protects you from voided manufacturer warranties, failed municipal inspections, and personal liability that unlicensed work can create. Every job we complete is done to code and fully documented.

The diagnostic fee you pay at the service call applies directly toward the repair cost. It is not a sunk cost, if the repair moves forward, you pay only once. That structure reduces the risk of picking up the phone when something goes wrong.

Maverick Ambitions HVAC is locally owned and operated from 52 Cypress St, Newark, NJ 07108, not a franchise, not a call center routing jobs to subcontractors. We are available 24 hours a day, every day of the year, and we answer our own phones.

HVAC COVERAGE ACROSS NEWARK AND 20+ NORTHERN NEW JERSEY COMMUNITIES

We serve Newark and the surrounding communities across Essex, Union, and Hudson counties. That includes East Orange, Irvington, Orange, West Orange, Bloomfield, Elizabeth, Belleville, and Kearny, among others. For the full list of covered areas, visit our Service Areas page or give us a call.

See All Service Areas

COMMON HVAC QUESTIONS FROM NEWARK HOMEOWNERS

Maverick Ambitions HVAC answers the questions Newark-area homeowners ask most before booking a service call.

Does Maverick Ambitions HVAC really offer 24-hour emergency HVAC service in Newark?

Yes, we offer genuine 24/7 availability every day of the year, including weekends and holidays. When you call (862) 279-3408, a real technician responds, not an answering service. Operating from our base at 52 Cypress St, Newark, we reach most Newark-area calls within a short drive.

Which cities does Maverick Ambitions HVAC serve?

We are based in Newark and cover Essex, Union, and Hudson counties, including East Orange, Irvington, Elizabeth, Bloomfield, Jersey City, Union Township, West Orange, and Belleville. Visit /service-areas for the full list of communities we serve.

Is Maverick Ambitions HVAC licensed and insured in New Jersey?

Yes, we hold Master HVAC License 19HC00912900, which you can verify through the New Jersey Division of Consumer Affairs. We also carry full liability insurance. Licensed work protects your manufacturer warranty and ensures the job passes municipal inspection, something unlicensed contractors cannot guarantee.

Does the diagnostic fee get applied toward the repair cost?

Yes, the diagnostic fee you pay at the service call applies toward your total repair cost. It is not a separate charge on top of the repair. If the repair moves forward, you pay only once. Call (862) 279-3408 to book a diagnostic visit.

How long has Maverick Ambitions HVAC been serving Newark?

We have been operating in Newark since 2012, under founder John Brown, who brings 23 years of hands-on HVAC experience. We are locally owned and operated from 52 Cypress St, Newark, not a franchise and not a national chain routing calls to subcontractors.

REACH MAVERICK AMBITIONS HVAC ANY TIME, DAY OR NIGHT

Same-day service is available, and the diagnostic fee applies toward the repair cost. The fastest way to reach us is (862) 279-3408.

MAVERICK AMBITIONS HVAC SERVES NEWARK, AROUND THE CLOCK

Maverick Ambitions HVAC is a licensed HVAC contractor serving Newark, NJ and surrounding communities across Essex, Union, and Hudson counties since 2012, holding Master HVAC License 19HC00912900.

Maverick Ambitions HVAC is a Newark-based HVAC company founded in 2012. We install, repair, and maintain residential and commercial heating and cooling systems across northern New Jersey. Licensed under Master HVAC License 19HC00912900, we operate 24 hours a day, seven days a week, including emergency response.

JOHN BROWN BUILT THIS BUSINESS ON 23 YEARS OF HANDS-ON HVAC WORK

John Brown has worked in the HVAC trade for 23 years. In 2012, he established Maverick Ambitions HVAC, a deliberate decision to build something permanent in the community where he works.

Newark's housing stock is genuinely varied. Two-family homes in the North Ward, multi-unit Ironbound buildings with aging ductwork, older South Ward properties with equipment that predates modern efficiency standards, each situation teaches you something. That depth of local knowledge shows up on every job in how we size equipment, route ductwork, and match systems to the actual structure, not a generic spec sheet.

We work 24 hours a day, seven days a week. John Brown's team handles every job directly, no subcontractors, no handoffs. The expertise you expect when you call us is what actually shows up at your door, every time.

VERIFIED CREDENTIALS THAT PROTECT EVERY CUSTOMER
Master HVAC License 19HC00912900

Maverick Ambitions HVAC holds New Jersey Master HVAC License 19HC00912900, verifiable through the NJ Division of Consumer Affairs. Every installation and repair is performed by a licensed technician, no unlicensed subcontractors, no shortcuts.

Operating in Newark Since 2012

Founded at 52 Cypress St, Newark, NJ 07108, Maverick Ambitions HVAC has completed residential and commercial HVAC work across Essex, Union, and Hudson counties for over a decade. Local roots mean faster response and genuine familiarity with Newark's housing stock.

24-Hour Availability, Every Day of the Year

We answer calls at 2 a.m. in July and on Thanksgiving morning in November. Our 24-hour availability is an operational fact, not a marketing line, and it includes genuine emergency response for both residential and commercial customers.

Fully insured. No diagnostic fee is ever a sunk cost; it applies toward your repair.

COMMON QUESTIONS ABOUT MAVERICK AMBITIONS HVAC
Is Maverick Ambitions HVAC a licensed HVAC contractor in New Jersey?

Yes. Maverick Ambitions HVAC holds New Jersey Master HVAC License 19HC00912900, issued by the NJ Division of Consumer Affairs. We carry full liability insurance, and the license has been active since we established the business in Newark in 2012. Every job is performed by a licensed technician on staff.

How long has Maverick Ambitions HVAC been in business in Newark?

We have operated continuously from our Newark base at 52 Cypress St since 2012. Founder John Brown brings 23 years of hands-on HVAC experience to that tenure, meaning our institutional knowledge of Newark's residential and commercial stock stretches well beyond our founding year.

Who actually does the HVAC work; is it employees or subcontractors?

Every job is handled by Maverick Ambitions HVAC's own technicians, we do not subcontract. That matters because it means the same level of expertise and accountability shows up on every visit, with no handoff to an unknown third party whose training and licensing we cannot vouch for directly.

What makes Maverick Ambitions HVAC different from other Newark HVAC companies?

Our 24-hour availability is genuine, you reach a technician, not an answering service. The diagnostic fee you pay applies toward your repair cost, so it is never money spent for nothing. We are locally owned and operate out of 52 Cypress St in Newark, which means faster dispatch and real familiarity with the city's housing stock.

CALL MAVERICK AMBITIONS HVAC TODAY

Reach us any time, day or night, weekends and holidays included. Our team answers every call and dispatches from our Newark base at 52 Cypress St.

Call (862) 279-3408
